questions.q: How many official skills-measured domains does DP-700 have, and how are they weighted?
options: Three domains, each weighted roughly 30-35% — a near-even split
Five domains, with one dominant domain worth 60%
Two domains, split 50/50
One domain that covers everything equally
questions.explain: Implement/manage, ingest/transform, and monitor/optimize each sit in roughly the same 30-35% range.

questions.q: What does Domain 1, 'Implement and manage an analytics solution,' primarily cover?
options: Setting up the Fabric environment: workspaces, OneLake, Lakehouses, Warehouses, capacities, security, and Git integration
Only KQL query syntax
Only Spark notebook code
Only cost optimization
questions.explain: This maps to Fabric & Real-Time Analytics Chapter 1, drilled directly in Lesson 28.

questions.q: What does Domain 2, 'Ingest and transform data,' primarily cover?
options: Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Eventstreams, notebooks, and Spark-based transformations
Only exam registration logistics
Only Power BI report design
Only Azure subscription billing
questions.explain: This maps to Fabric Chapter 2 plus Delta Lake mechanics from the Databricks course, drilled in Lesson 29.

questions.q: What does Domain 3, 'Monitor and optimize an analytics solution,' primarily cover?
options: The Monitoring Hub, Direct Lake Mode performance, capacity/SKU sizing, and production practices like CI/CD and incident response
Only how to write a resume
Only dimensional modeling
Only how to create a workspace
questions.explain: This maps to Fabric Chapter 3's production practices, scoped to what a certification question asks, drilled in Lesson 30.

questions.q: Why does the near-even weighting across all three domains matter for how you study?
options: Because no domain is safe to skim — missing one entirely risks roughly a third of the exam
Because only Domain 1 actually appears on the real exam
Because the weighting is irrelevant to study planning
Because Domain 3 is worth zero points
questions.explain: Unlike exams with one dominant domain, DP-700's near-equal split means all three domains need real coverage.
